test_set: The first 5 shots captured after config.json's frozen_at whose capture is complete (fresh_run.eligibility), in capture order. Excluded only for those mechanical reasons, decided by preserve before any request. Shots after the fifth are surplus and never sent. Shots captured before this freeze, including the V1 test set, are not eligible.
protocol: Exactly one OpenAI request per test shot (fresh_v2_run.py run <shot> --send). No retries. No change between shots to the V2 prompt, model, reasoning effort, T36S, impact prior, V2 validator or schema: --send refuses if any fingerprinted file, setting, system-prompt hash or schema hash differs from config.json.

grading.when: Canonical labels are sealed (fresh_v2_run.py label <shot>) BEFORE the request. label refuses once reply.json exists. The sealed file is copied into the run and its SHA-256 is written to the ledger with the reply. evaluate refuses a label or reply whose bytes no longer match the ledger.
grading.what: Per camera, from the canonical full-resolution originals, not from the model's cells: contact_tick and, for P1-P9, the best capture ticks and the acceptable capture ticks. Every P6 acceptable tick lies after every P5 best tick and before contact_tick. Labels hold capture ticks only, never a sheet cell ID. The model's raw cell is then compared with those labels.
grading.contact_tick: contact_tick is the capture tick where the clubhead is at the ball and the struck ball is still on/at the mat. A later frame where the ball has already departed is post-impact and must not be labelled contact.
grading.p6: P6 is shaft-parallel-to-ground during downswing/delivery. Because capture cadence may place exact shaft-horizontal between two frames, the nearest captured frame BETWEEN a valid P5 and P7 is acceptable when the shaft has clearly just passed or is just approaching horizontal. It must not be graded acceptable merely because it is temporally near P6: the visible shaft geometry must support it.
grading.correct: The model's capture tick is one of the pre-recorded best ticks.
grading.acceptable: The model's capture tick is one of the pre-recorded acceptable ticks.
grading.wrong: The model's capture tick is neither best nor acceptable.
grading.unavailable: The model returned no cell, or a number naming no picture. shown_on_sheet is true when any acceptable tick for that position is an available cell of that camera on the T36S sheet.

metrics.M1: P3-P8. Slots: 5 shots x 2 cameras x P3..P8 = 60. good = correct|acceptable; bad = wrong, or unavailable with the position shown on the sheet; excluded = unavailable and not shown. M1 = good / (good + bad). PASS if >= 0.90.
metrics.M2: Same rule over P6-P9 (40 slots). PASS if >= 0.95.
metrics.M3: P7. Per shot x camera (10): pass when the returned P7 capture index is within +/-1 of that camera's pre-recorded contact_tick. A null P7 fails. PASS if >= 9 of 10.
metrics.M4: Accepted checkpoints (after validation, every position P1-P9, as in V1) whose owning raw group is graded wrong, divided by all accepted checkpoints. PASS if <= 0.05.
metrics.M5: Wire/schema failures, summed, as in V1. PASS if == 0.
metrics.M6: OpenAI latency: reply.json wall_seconds. PASS if every call <= 15.0 s. The median is reported against the preferred ~10 s and is not a gate.
metrics.overall: PASS only if M1-M6 all pass.
